Here is the API you need: MARKETPLACE: const MP=require('./city-marketplace'); const mp=new MP(); mp.postProblem({title,description,domain,difficulty,postedBy}). SESSION FILES in .sessions/*.json: {id,model,status,task,summary,turn,maxTurns,history:[{results:[{type,success}]}],updated}. status values: completed,failed,max_turns. SESSION LOG .session-log.jsonl: {sessionId,event,turn,success,action_results:[{type,success}]} event values: created,turn,model_error. CLI: --scan --propagate --snapshot --json --help. module.exports=FailurePropagator. After WRITE, run EXEC node .fastops/city-col-propagate.js --scan to verify it works.
